name: CalDAV Calendar
description: Displays a calendar collection through read-only CalDAV requests.

calendarUrl.title: Calendar collection URL
calendarUrl.description: Exact CalDAV URL of one calendar collection, not the provider's web interface. The default is Digital Peak's public DPCalendar demo.

username.title: Username
username.description: CalDAV login name. The public demo uses demo.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use a dedicated app password when your provider offers one. The public demo uses demo.

calendarName.title: Calendar label
calendarName.description: Optional display label for the selected calendar collection.

allowHttp.title: Allow insecure HTTP
allowHttp.description: Requires PAPERLESSPAPER_ALLOW_INSECURE_CALENDAR_HTTP=true on the server. Prefer HTTPS.

view.title: View & design
view.description: Choose an agenda, Today & next, or the next 7 days as day lists or a time grid. Rolling views start today. Day, 3-day, calendar week and year views are also available. Day timeline shows today with a time axis and an optional next-event sidebar.

fontSize.title: Font size (%)
fontSize.description: Scale calendar text from 75% to 400%. Dense views may reduce text to fit.

noPadding.title: Remove outer padding
noPadding.description: Use the full display area without an outer margin around the calendar.

fullWeekdayNames.title: Full weekday names
fullWeekdayNames.description: Spell out weekdays in day, 3-day and week views.

locale.title: Date locale
locale.description: BCP 47 locale, for example en-GB or de-DE.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone used for queries, visible ranges, and floating event times.

maxEvents.title: Maximum visible events
maxEvents.description: Presentation limit; the adapter independently keeps up to 500 occurrences.

showDaySummary.title: Day at a glance
showDaySummary.description: Show remaining timed events, all-day events, the next appointment and the last known end time today. Based on loaded calendar data at the displayed update time.

automaticEventIcons.title: Suggest event icons automatically
automaticEventIcons.description: Recognize common German and English event titles locally. Explicit [icon:…] codes take priority. Requires Show event icons.

showHeader.title: Show calendar header
showHeader.description: Show the provider heading or your personal heading. The day summary is controlled separately.

personalTitle.title: Personal heading
personalTitle.description: For example: Our week. Leave blank to keep the existing heading.

personalSubtitle.title: Personal subtitle
personalSubtitle.description: For example: Family Müller · Home & away. Leave blank to keep the existing subtitle.

informationDensity.title: Information density
informationDensity.description: Automatic fits text to the available space. Standard preserves the existing layout; compact shows more, spacious emphasizes readability. Font size remains independently adjustable. Extra appointments in modern and rolling lists are counted as + more.

timelineShowSidebar.title: Timeline: next event and due list
timelineShowSidebar.description: Show the next appointment and today’s [todo] deadlines/all-day events next to the timeline. In portrait they move below it.

timelineShowNow.title: Timeline: current time marker
timelineShowNow.description: Show a red Now marker at the last calendar refresh, without a numeric clock label.

timelineShowGaps.title: Timeline: free time gaps
timelineShowGaps.description: Label gaps between known timed commitments. All-day events or missing end times suppress gap labels. Based only on loaded events.
